# QuotaPin 1.0.4

This release establishes a clean cross-platform stable baseline for QuotaPin.

- **Windows:** run `QuotaPin-1.0.4.exe` for guided per-user setup.
- **macOS:** open `QuotaPin-macOS-1.0.4.dmg`, then double-click **QuotaPin Installer**. The universal image contains native Apple silicon and Intel builds.
- **Consistent update discovery:** the panel and tray select the matching platform package from the exact reviewed release asset set.
- **No forced Codex restart:** installation and updates keep an active Codex session open. If safe attachment is unavailable, QuotaPin waits for the next normal launch.
- **Configuration preserved:** guided setup, repair, and update keep existing views and preferences.
- **Windows acceptance target:** x64 Windows 11 is verified; x64 Windows 10 version 2004 and later remains best effort. Windows ARM64 is not supported.

Windows Quick Start:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS Quick Start:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash
```

The macOS package is ad-hoc signed and CI-validated. Signed-in real-device and Gatekeeper acceptance remains provisional.
